messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: seeing files not checked in?
parts:
We were trying to do the current release and I got
bit by having some .o files lying around that hugely
inflated the size. We tracked them down by divide
and conquer on the files.

I wasn't seeing them on "git status" because there
was a general .gitignore for .o files.

Is there a way to see things in the directory that
aren't in version control?

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] seeing files not checked in?
parts:
Daniel figured it out:

> git clean -n -x

And then to get rid of them

> git clean -f -x

I thought it'd be a bit extreme to do that automatically
on our dist target.

- Bob
